name: Ohio State University
tuition_note: In-state (Ohio resident) tuition & fees $14,034 for 2026-27, Columbus campus, from OSU Student Financial Aid cost of attendance page (sfa.osu.edu/incoming-freshmen/about-aid/financial-aid-eligibility). Housing figure $15,630 is the on-campus 'living expenses: housing and food' combined line from the same COA page; OSU does not publish a standalone room-only annual figure (housing.osu.edu standard-housing-rates page shows no dollar amounts), so room+board is used.
